touchpoints.name: Alerta aplicación
touchpoints.query: SELECT count(*) FROM PageView WHERE error IS true FACET appName SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Registro módulo dato rendimiento
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Log FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Entidad servicios
touchpoints.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE error IS true FACET name SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Aplicación estado cloud servicios alerta
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE name LIKE 'WebTransaction/%' FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago
